The railing system on the right exhibits inconsistent perspective lines. Some bars appear to pass through each other or fade out unnaturally, lacking proper occlusion logic.

The graffiti on the yellow walls looks like smeared texture rather than distinct applied paint or scratches. The transition between the 'clean' yellow paint and the 'dirty' areas is overly smooth and airbrushed, lacking realistic grime accumulation.
The geometric shapes of the skylights are slightly irregular and soft-edged, suggesting minor melting or generation blur rather than sharp architectural lines.
